symbols.title: State symbols of the Republic of Kazakhstan
symbols.lead: The state symbols are the Flag, the Emblem and the Anthem. The brief notes follow the official website of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

facts.lawValue: Constitutional Law “On State Symbols of the Republic of Kazakhstan” of 4 June 2007
facts.adoptedValue: The Flag and the Emblem in 1992, the Anthem in 2006

flag.title: State Flag
flag.text: A rectangular sky-blue cloth. In the centre is a sun with rays and a soaring eagle beneath it; at the hoist is a vertical band with a national ornament. The sun, the eagle and the ornament are gold. The width of the flag is half its length.
flag.authors: Designed by the artist Shaken Niyazbekov.
flag.link: The Flag on the President's website

emblem.title: State Emblem
emblem.text: The Emblem is circular. In the centre, on a blue background, is a shanyrak from which uyks spread like the rays of the sun; mythical winged horses stand on either side, a five-pointed star is at the top and the inscription “Qazaqstan” at the bottom. All the elements are gold.
emblem.authors: Designed by the architects Zhandarbek Malibekov and Shot-Aman Ualikhanov.
emblem.link: The Emblem on the President's website

anthem.title: State Anthem
anthem.text: The Anthem is based on the song “Menin Qazaqstanym”. Parliament approved it on 6 January 2006; it was first performed on 11 January 2006.
anthem.authors: Music by Shamshi Kaldayakov, lyrics by Zhumeken Nazhimedenov and Nursultan Nazarbayev.
anthem.link: The Anthem on the President's website

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What data the site receives, why, and who it is passed to. The catalogue, news and reference sections are open without registration.

data.title: What data is needed for browsing
data.text: None. Browsing the catalogue, exhibitions, news and reference sections requires no registration, and the site does not ask for personal data for this.

search.title: Search queries and questions to the assistant
search.text: Queries may be stored in anonymised form for statistics, without an IP address or a visitor identifier. The archive assistant runs on the archive's server: questions are not passed to external AI services.

cabinet.title: Personal account
cabinet.text: Registration is voluntary. The account stores your e-mail address, your password in encrypted form and what you add yourself: favourites, selections and saved searches.

location.title: Location and starting address
location.text: Your location is requested only after you press the button on a branch page and is not sent to the archive's server. A starting address entered by hand is sent to the OpenStreetMap address search service (Nominatim). The starting point reaches an external map service only when you open directions through a link.

cookies.title: Cookies and settings
cookies.text: The browser stores the selected language, the colour theme and the settings of the version for visually impaired users. A session cookie is used only after you sign in to the personal account or the site management system.

external.title: External sites
external.text: eGov.kz, e-Otinish, Adilet, social networks and map services follow their own data processing rules.

contact.title: Questions about data
contact.text: For questions about the processing of personal data, contact the archive: phone numbers and e-mail are in the Contacts section.
